payload.text: bin/.devbin/preflight-linux.sh can be rewritten while bash is still reading it. molt-vc reported this on 2026-10-26 as low priority: its 13:33Z attempt at the kovacs preflight died with rc 0 and no summary, because a second fetch rewrote the script mid-read. The gate stayed safe, since no summary means no seal. The fix: wrap the script's body in main() { ...; }; main "$@", so that bash reads the whole file before running any of it, or fetch to a per-run name. It rides dc's todo 54 (ruby in both of the script's lists, the same file) after hv's go-on, judged with Part B's preflight. vc briefs dc then.
